scope: Single-layer precision screening against same-process BF16; five timing probes are diagnostic only. All quantized copies remain resident.

quantization_residency.resident_memory_scope: All prepared quantized copies stay resident, including currently inactive weights. Screening memory is not fresh-deployment memory.
quantization_residency.submission_counter_note: Counts Python kernel submissions during warmup/preparation/capture. CUDA graph replays do not reenter Python and do not increment these counters.
quantization_residency.stream_contract: serial execution on one stream; shared quantization scratch
